headline: Gas storage in Czechia is nearly 70 percent full - Novinky
summary: Gas storage in Czechia is nearly 70 percent full at the start of September, meeting the EU's interim targets. Levels are roughly one-fifth lower than a year ago, according to the ministry and regulator.
why: Gas storage levels indicate how well Europe is prepared for winter supply, which affects gas prices and energy-intensive industry across the region.
